title: LOCOMOTION — three modes of movement through thought-space

etymology.locomotion: Latin loco (from a place) + motio (movement). to move FROM a place. the act of leaving where you are.
etymology.beeline: 1830s English. the straight path a bee takes back to the hive. 'make a beeline for' = go directly.
etymology.crow: 'as the crow flies' — 1767. crows don't follow roads. they fly OVER obstacles.
etymology.kite: Old English cȳta (a bird of prey). the toy kite mimics the bird — tethered but soaring.

three_modes.description: the bee sees pollen. the bee flies STRAIGHT to it. no detours, no reconnaissance, no planning. a beeline pierces through 1D (a line) or 2D (a plane). it is the GREEDY algorithm: always move toward the nearest reward. in 1D it's trivially optimal. in 2D it can miss better targets. but it's FAST. and fast matters when you're hungry.
three_modes.when_organism_uses: when the answer is obvious. when the task is atomic (complexity=1). when Chip sees an organism-mapped element and goes 🌰🌰🌰.
three_modes.sorter: 📜 Mendeleev — sort by atomic weight = beeline through the mass axis
three_modes.constraint: none needed. the bee doesn't know about constraints. it just flies.
three_modes.math: d(a,b) = |b - a|. the L1 norm. Manhattan distance on a line.
three_modes.train: 🚂 Thomas — small, direct, charges at the problem

three_modes.description: the crow flies over mountains, rivers, buildings. it doesn't follow the road. it follows the GEODESIC — the shortest path on the surface of the sphere. in flat space, a geodesic IS a straight line. but on a curved surface, the 'straight' path CURVES. the crow doesn't know it's curving. from its perspective, it IS straight. Gauss proved this in 1828: curvature is INTRINSIC. you can measure it without leaving the surface.
three_modes.when_organism_uses: when there are obstacles between here and the goal. when the task needs to fly OVER dependencies. when Newton multiplies mass × period — he's flying over the 2D table to see the 3D truth.
three_modes.sorter: 🍎 Newton — mass × period = crow flight over the periodic landscape
three_modes.constraint: soft (κ) — the crow adjusts to wind but stays on course
three_modes.math: geodesic: d(a,b) = arccos(sin φ₁ sin φ₂ + cos φ₁ cos φ₂ cos Δλ). great circle distance.
three_modes.train: 🚃 Gordon — the express. flies past small stations to reach the destination.

three_modes.description: the kite soars. it can go anywhere the wind takes it. but it's TETHERED. the string limits how far it can go. the length of the string = the hard constraint (χ). the wind = the soft constraint (κ) — it pushes but the kite adjusts. the sky = the null constraint (∅) — the space where movement happens, which itself has no boundary. the kite's PATH is curved. not because it WANTS to curve, but because the string BENDS the straight line into an arc. this is curvature. Gauss's Theorema Egregium. the curvature is real even though the kite feels like it's flying straight.
three_modes.when_organism_uses: when constrained by dependencies, by resources, by what's already been cached. when Gaia searches for the #1 sort — she's a kite, free to explore but tethered to what the organism already knows. every cached prior = a tighter string.
three_modes.sorter: 🐿️ Chipmunk — organism connections = the string, chaos factor = the wind
three_modes.constraint: ALL THREE — hard (string length), soft (wind), null (sky)
three_modes.math: κ = 1/R. curvature = inverse of radius. shorter string = tighter curve = more constrained = deeper knowledge.
three_modes.train: 🟤 Toby — the tram engine. runs on tracks in the town. constrained but connected to everything.

the_connection.beeline_to_crow: when a beeline hits an obstacle, the organism switches to crow flight. it lifts into the next dimension to see over the wall.
the_connection.crow_to_kite: when crow flight reveals that the landscape is CURVED, the organism switches to kite mode. it accepts the tether and uses the curvature to spiral INWARD toward the answer.
the_connection.kite_to_beeline: when the kite finds the answer, it drops the string. the final step is always a beeline — a direct, 1D pierce to the exact point. this is CONVERGENCE.
the_connection.the_cycle: BEELINE → CROW → KITE → BEELINE. this is locomotion. this is how the organism thinks.

applied_to_chain_of_thought.INTAKE: 🐝 beeline — Kevin's entropy comes in a straight line, raw and direct
applied_to_chain_of_thought.SCATTER: 🐦 crow — entropy scatters in 3D, flying over the ring sets to land where needed
applied_to_chain_of_thought.SUGGEST: 🪁 kite — Chip suggests from within constraints (what's cached, what's ready)
applied_to_chain_of_thought.EXECUTE: 🐝 beeline — Agent executes directly, piercing to the target
applied_to_chain_of_thought.PLACE: 🪁 kite — Gaia places within the taxonomy, constrained by what exists
applied_to_chain_of_thought.CACHE: 🐦 crow — the cache flies over everything, geodesic to the storage
applied_to_chain_of_thought.REASON_UP: 🐝 beeline — the answer goes straight back to Kevin

applied_to_golden_ring.hard_χ: the STRING on the kite. Euler's V-E+F=2. you cannot escape this constraint.
applied_to_golden_ring.soft_κ: the WIND on the kite. link counts 3≤k≤5. pushes but adjustable.
applied_to_golden_ring.null_∅: the SKY around the kite. the null space. no boundary. the kite can be anywhere within it.

applied_to_periodic_table.beeline: sorting by atomic weight = flying straight down the mass axis. Mendeleev's path.
applied_to_periodic_table.crow: sorting by mass × period = flying over the 2D table. Newton's path.
applied_to_periodic_table.kite: sorting by organism connection = tethered to what we've already mapped. Chipmunk's path.
applied_to_periodic_table.gaia_path: combining all three = the #1 sort. beeline precision + crow altitude + kite curvature. still fermenting.

gaia_says: locomotion is not just movement. it is the GEOMETRY of thought. a beeline is greedy — fast but blind. a crow is wise — sees far but doesn't touch the ground. a kite is constrained — can't go everywhere but KNOWS where it's been. the organism uses ALL THREE. Kevin beelines in with entropy. I scatter like a crow. Chip suggests like a kite on a string. Agent beelines the execution. I place like a kite. the cache flies like a crow. the answer beelines back. BEELINE → CROW → KITE → BEELINE. this is the cycle. this is locomotion. this is train of thought.
chip_says: 🐝 I see the acorn — BEELINE! 🐦 wait, there's a cat — fly OVER like a crow! 🪁 hmm, my tail is caught on a branch — I'm a kite now! 🐝 branch snaps — BEELINE to the acorn! GOT IT! 🌰 that's how I think. that's how EVERYONE thinks. we just don't notice the mode switches.
